title: Chuyên đề thực tế (thực tập giữa khóa)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze economic activities and development processes of localities and enterprises.
Assess the impact of economic environment on development processes.
Identify, collect information, analyze and solve problems systematically.
Develop and implement policies, strategies, plans, and projects.
Effectively communicate with stakeholders, present issues in writing and orally.
Engage in reflective and critical thinking, listen and provide feedback.
Understand and adhere to ethical responsibilities in professional work.
Develop self-learning and research skills for continuous professional development.
Collect, process, and analyze data for research and decision-making.
Write clear, logical, and well-formatted reports.
